contract_absence_shape: DriverAbsenceSchema = AbsenceSchema.extend({verdict: absent-verified|lookup-failed|not-served}); the observation is a DriverObservationSchema discriminated union whose observed branch takes ObservationSchema + DerivationProvenance and whose unobserved branch takes a DriverObservationAbsence (servedElsewhere required, withheldNote and blockedBy optional) + RecordProvenance
futures_node_name_evidence: Not a naming gap: the security master classifies CL/GC/ES/SI/NG/ZB/M6E as asset_class "equity", resolution_status "provisional", name null, identifiers [], issuer withheld ("no trusted issuer link"); no node resolves for CLZ25/GCZ25/ESZ25, so it holds no futures nodes at all. AAPL is the control: same equity class and null name, but issuer_available true with issuer.name "Apple Inc.", which is why its twin builds and CL's 503s. No honest fix in this repo, since a name would be synthesised from a symbol whose equity meaning is Colgate-Palmolive.
